· Position relative to SMA100/200 (142,456/107,304 KRW): mid-to-long-term trend shows weakness.

· MACD histogram trajectory (1212.6516→954.8055): worsening trend, no signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 107,181 KRW): consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (94,590 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (98,988 KRW).
· Swing resistance (115,010 KRW): close to 5-day high (114,925 KRW), potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: indicates sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.95x): moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, entry decision pending confirmation of breakout above 115,010 KRW resistance.
